title: Home Oxygen Therapy Contents Months Alongside a PAP Therapy Equipment Device
content:
# Contents Months Alongside a PAP Device — Home Oxygen Therapy

**Rule.** For a Home Oxygen Therapy contents month paid in full by the coverage, the contents amount is multiplied by **97 percent** when the patient's PAP Therapy Equipment device record names the same coverage as the oxygen record, carries no ownership date, has fewer than 13 PAP rental months paid and began its payment period at least **3** whole calendar months before the posting date; by **99 percent** when the PAP device record carries an ownership date or 13 or more PAP rental months have been paid; and by **100 percent** otherwise. The multiplication acts on the amount as it stands, without rounding.

## What is read on the PAP Therapy Equipment record

- the coverage the PAP device record names;
- whether it carries an ownership date;
- the number of PAP rental months paid on its claim history;
- its payment-period start date, measured in whole calendar months to the posting date.

## Truth table

| Names the oxygen record's coverage | Ownership date | PAP rental months paid | Payment period began 3 or more whole months before posting | Percentage |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| yes | none | 12 or fewer | yes | 97 |
| yes | none | 12 or fewer | no | 100 |
| no | none | 12 or fewer | either | 100 |
| either | present | any | either | 99 |
| either | none | 13 or more | either | 99 |
| no PAP device record | — | — | — | 100 |

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

A contents amount of 79.12 for a patient whose PAP device is owned becomes 79.12 multiplied by 99 percent, 78.3288, carried unrounded.
